## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL (SDPA forward placement).

## Summary

`_sm100_paged_full_square` is a new placement arm on cc 10.0. It covers paged bf16 d128 **full-prefill squares** (Q = KV) with:
- b 1–4, page 16, head-major in-page K, causal, no window or sink;
- **GQA 4 / 8 / 16 and 1024 ≤ S ≤ 8192**.

In that box the FROST block now leads. MHA and group 2 keep the backend.

## Why

Before this change, full paged prefill on SM100 defaulted to backend engine 10 outside the existing GQA16 / bounded-chunk box. I ran a legal-pool sweep (every FROST knob set plus the backend, timed per case) over mixed-length full paged prefills on an SM100 board. FROST's *first* plan beat engine 10 on 11 of 12 shapes, at 0.55–0.84× its time. The exception was a single 4096-token group-2 square.

A holdout was frozen before the rule was written, with 24 cases across groups 1–16 and S up to 8192:
- **GQA cases inside the box:** every one improved, at 0.49–0.94× engine 10.
- **MHA:** an MHA case at S = 2048 regressed (1.03×), and group 2 had no in-box case.
- **Decision:** the rule keeps only the GQA band. The MHA/group-2 band was removed rather than refit.

The same holdout was then run through FlashInfer's paged prefill wrapper on a B200, with bounded and exact page-table forms. Every changed default was faster in both traversal orders, and the full FP64 O / LSE, replay and capture checks passed.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Python-side default ordering only. Capabilities and EngineSpecs are unchanged (exempt from SDPA Rule S2).

## Testing

```
pytest test/python/sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_heuristics.py test/python/sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_placement.py \
       test/python/sdpa/frost/test_heuristic_geometry.py test/python/sdpa/frost/test_flashinfer_consumed_surface.py \
       -m "L0 or L1 or L2 or L3 or L4"
1296 passed, 2 skipped
```

New test: `test_sm100_paged_full_square_leads_inside_its_box`. It covers G4/G8/G16 leading, MHA / G2 staying on the backend, and the S < 1024, S > 8192 and cc 10.3 edges.

files.patch:
@@ -321,6 +321,12 @@
 declaration and bounded MHA / group 2 showed no material gap and still trail. FlashInfer's exact declarations leave
 ``max_total_seq_len_q`` unset (capacity b * max_q), so GQA 4 / 8 lead there too. Measured on cc 10.0 only.
 
+SM100 paged bf16 d128 full squares (2026-10-25, ``_sm100_paged_full_square``): Q = KV per graph (full paged prefill),
+b 1-4, page 16, head-major in-page K, causal, no window / sink: GQA 4 / 8 / 16 lead for 1024 <= S <= 8192. A
+legal-pool sweep over mixed-length full prefills found FROST's first plan ahead of engine 10 on these shapes, and a
+separately frozen holdout confirmed every GQA case in the box. MHA and group 2 keep the backend: an MHA holdout case at
+S = 2048 lost and group 2 was not covered.
+
 Rows with no measurement (SM80, SM100 mxfp8) keep the historical order (LEAD); they are still
 opt-in, so the order is only observable with ``CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1``.
 """
@@ -777,6 +783,27 @@ def _in_paged_d256_prefill_domain(facts) -> bool:
     )
 
 
+def _sm100_paged_full_square(facts) -> bool:
+    """cc 10.0 paged bf16 d128 full prefill (Q = KV), page 16, head-major in-page K (module docstring)."""
+    group = facts.h_q // facts.h_kv if facts.h_kv and facts.h_q % facts.h_kv == 0 else 0
+    return (
+        facts.device_cc == (10, 0)
+        and facts.has_paged_kv
+        and facts.dtype == cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+        and (facts.d_qk, facts.d_v) == (128, 128)
+        and 1 <= facts.b <= SM100_PAGED_GQA16_MAX_B
+        and facts.s_q == facts.s_kv
+        and group in (4, 8, 16)
+        and 1024 <= facts.s_q <= 8192
+        and facts.page_size == 16
+        and facts.causal
+        and facts.window_left is None
+        and not (facts.has_sink or facts.right_band_widening)
+        and facts.k_t is not None
+        and facts.k_t.get_stride()[2] < facts.k_t.get_stride()[1]
+    )
+
+
 def _sm100_paged_gqa_prefill(facts) -> bool:
     """cc 10.0 paged bf16 d128 GQA prefill, page 16, head-major in-page K (module docstring): GQA16 exact or bounded;
     GQA 4 / 8 when the declared total-Q capacity is loose (``shape_overrides`` or no ``max_total_seq_len_q``)."""
@@ -809,7 +836,7 @@ def _place_sm100_f16(caps: Capabilities, facts) -> str:
         return LEAD
     if nonpaged_thd_split_choice(caps, facts)[0] > 1:
         return LEAD
-    if _sm100_paged_gqa_prefill(facts):
+    if _sm100_paged_gqa_prefill(facts) or _sm100_paged_full_square(facts):
         return LEAD
     dense = not facts.thd
     if dense and 2 <= facts.s_q <= DECODE_SHAPED_MAX_S_Q:

@@ -889,6 +889,24 @@ def test_sm107_paged_gqa_prefill_leads_inside_its_box():
     assert place(s_kv=65536) == placement.TRAIL
 
 
+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_sm100_paged_full_square_leads_inside_its_box():
+    """cc 10.0 paged bf16 d128 full prefill squares lead for GQA 4/8/16, 1024 <= S <= 8192; MHA / group 2 keep the backend."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import ENGINE_SPECS
+
+    spec = next(s for s in ENGINE_SPECS if s.name == "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100")
+    base = dict(b=2, s_q=1536, s_kv=1536, bottom_right=False, max_total_seq_len_q=None, device_cc=(10, 0), device_sm_count=148)
+    place = lambda **over: placement.place(spec, _sm107_paged_facts(**{**base, **over}))
+    for h_q, h_kv in ((16, 4), (8, 1), (64, 4)):
+        assert place(h_q=h_q, h_kv=h_kv) == placement.LEAD, (h_q, h_kv)
+    for h_q, h_kv in ((8, 8), (16, 8)):
+        assert not placement._sm100_paged_full_square(_sm107_paged_facts(**{**base, "h_q": h_q, "h_kv": h_kv}))
+    assert place(h_q=8, h_kv=1, b=1, s_q=8192, s_kv=8192) == placement.LEAD
+    assert place(h_q=16, h_kv=4, s_q=512, s_kv=512) == placement.TRAIL
+    assert place(h_q=8, h_kv=1, b=1, s_q=16384, s_kv=16384) == placement.TRAIL
+    assert place(h_q=16, h_kv=4, device_cc=(10, 3), device_sm_count=160) == placement.TRAIL
+
